title: P40 to P45 minimum wage hike approved in W. Visayas, Negros Occidental

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB) in Western Visayas has approved P40 to P45 daily minimum wage increase for private-sector workers, which is subject to approval of the labor secretary. RTWPB-6 chair Sixto Rodriguez Jr. on Saturday said that the hike covers workers in Western Visayas, Negros Occidental and Bacolod City, he said. Under Wage Order 30, agricultural workers will receive a P45 daily increase, raising their minimum wage from P520 to P565.
